name: Sazameki
source:
I have some friends with whom I can have everyday conversations, but I haven't been able to establish deeper relationships with anyone. Just being touched by a stranger makes me feel off. I hate myself for being like that. The spring I turned eighteen, I talked to a teacher about it. They suggested falling in love with someone. I wonder if I'll be able to change...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/6704]Freem![/url]]
translation:
我有幾個能日常閒聊的朋友，卻始終無法和任何人建立更深的關係。只要被陌生人碰一下，我就會覺得不舒服。我討厭這樣的自己。18歲那年春天，我找老師談起這件事。老師建議我試著喜歡上一個人。我真的能改變嗎……

[譯自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/6704]Freem![/url]]
